[list=1]
[*][size=2]Download the file[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Extract the contents to your Stardew Valley Mods folder[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Install all dependencies[/size][/*]
[/list][size=2]Use the toggles in this mod (using GMCM or editing config) for Gunnar's freckles and Sig's hair, not the Bear Family toggle.
